scope: Retrospective development comparison on the nine previously evaluated v0.53 cases. Rerun all three arms on one extracted historical KG backend; do not count historical prefix or evaluation measurements as new observations.
comparison: Three systems share 32 paid prefix vectors, 32 further simulator calls, the historical SC-KG backend, both GP heads, task changes and evaluation controls. The full-prior arm changes the GP representation using the historical full profile, preserving its pilot gate and coefficient adaptation. Hegel v0.53 also chooses research actions and can revise deployed explanations: this is a complete-system comparison, not an isolated prior-representation or recursion ablation.
structural_prior_data: Fit the historical four-property prior on the same current-task paid prefix. This adapts its acquisition input; it is not the original independent multi-domain source-training experiment. No new prior-training simulator calls.
